properties.name: Mills Field / San Francisco Airport NNE runway (1930s)
properties.note: one of the three 1930s runways ('three by 1936, forming a triangle'; paved and widened by 1937), north end marked '4 x' on the 1946 sheet; still drawn 1956, built over by the 1960s (taxiway grid / North Terminal area) - end = 1956 -> 1968 midpoint. Axis read on the 1946 sheet (+-30 m)

properties.name: NAS Oakland / North Field NW-SE diagonal runway
properties.note: wartime runway ('four asphalt runways, the longest 6,500 ft'), on the 1947-1979 editions, gone on the 1993 sheet (end = midpoint); axis read on the 1958-photo sheet (+-40 m)
